entries.title: Divine Aegis
entries.body:
# Divine Aegis

## Overview
When all hope seems lost, you may call upon your patron to manifest a Divine Aegis—a magnificent dome of sacred power that shields those within from the chaos beyond. More than a simple magical barrier, the Divine Aegis represents a fragment of your patron's divine domain, standing as an unyielding sanctuary amidst the fury of battle.

Though every Divine Aegis differs in appearance according to the patron who created it, each serves the same purpose. Some shimmer with radiant light, others swirl with celestial fire, sacred tides, spectral ravens, flourishing vines, crimson blood, or countless other divine manifestations. Whatever its form, those within know they stand beneath the protection of something far greater than themselves.

The Divine Aegis is not merely a wall—it is a declaration that, for a short time, the battlefield itself bends to the will of your patron.

## Rank 1
### Description

When all hope seems lost, you may call upon your patron to manifest a Divine Aegis—a magnificent dome of sacred power that shields those within from the chaos beyond. More than a simple magical barrier, the Divine Aegis represents a fragment of your patron's divine domain, standing as an unyielding sanctuary amidst the fury of battle.

Though every Divine Aegis differs in appearance according to the patron who created it, each serves the same purpose. Some shimmer with radiant light, others swirl with celestial fire, sacred tides, spectral ravens, flourishing vines, crimson blood, or countless other divine manifestations. Whatever its form, those within know they stand beneath the protection of something far greater than themselves.

The Divine Aegis is not merely a wall—it is a declaration that, for a short time, the battlefield itself bends to the will of your patron.

### Effects

- Spend **250 MP** and **30 SP** to create a stationary **Divine Aegis** centred on yourself.
- **Cooldown:** Long Rest.
- The Divine Aegis forms a **6-metre radius dome**.
- The Divine Aegis has **200 HP**.
- All physical and magical damage directed at the barrier is dealt to the Divine Aegis instead.
- When the Divine Aegis reaches **0 HP**, it immediately shatters and disappears.
- Creatures inside the Divine Aegis may leave it freely.
- Once a creature willingly leaves the Divine Aegis, it cannot re-enter that same Divine Aegis.
- The Divine Aegis blocks:
  - Weapon attacks.
  - Ammunition.
  - Magical projectiles.
  - Breath weapons.
  - Area effects that must pass through the barrier.
- Creatures, spells, enchantments, and effects aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** may pass through the Divine Aegis unhindered.
- Interactions with creatures and effects aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** are determined by your patron's **Religious Page**.
- Additional interactions granted through your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

Among the greatest miracles ever witnessed upon the battlefields of Asteria, few inspire more hope than the appearance of a Divine Aegis. Entire villages have survived impossible sieges beneath these sacred domes, while wounded champions found precious moments to recover before returning to the fight. To those sheltered within, the barrier is more than protection—it is a visible reminder that their patron has not abandoned them.

Every Divine Aegis reflects the nature of the deity who grants it. Though no two barriers appear alike, each marks the boundary between the mortal world and a fragment of the patron's divine domain. While it stands, the faithful know they are sheltered beneath the watchful gaze of something eternal.

> *"A wall of stone protects the body. A Divine Aegis protects hope itself."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your mastery over the Divine Aegis deepens, allowing your patron's sanctuary to manifest with greater strength and stability. The barrier expands further across the battlefield, sheltering more allies beneath its sacred protection while becoming increasingly difficult for hostile forces to overcome.

Those sheltered within the Aegis stand upon consecrated ground, protected by a fragment of your patron's divine domain. Every strike that crashes against its surface is absorbed by the barrier itself, preserving those inside until its sacred power is finally exhausted. Though the Aegis remains immovable, its presence alone can alter the course of an entire battle.

As your covenant grows stronger, so too does your patron's influence upon the barrier. Its appearance becomes more vivid, its divine presence more overwhelming, and its connection to your patron's element more apparent to both ally and enemy alike.

### Effects

- Spend **300 MP** and **40 SP** to create a stationary **Divine Aegis** centred on yourself.
- **Cooldown:** Long Rest.
- The Divine Aegis forms an **8-metre radius dome**.
- The Divine Aegis has **300 HP**.
- All physical and magical damage directed at the barrier is dealt to the Divine Aegis instead.
- When the Divine Aegis reaches **0 HP**, it immediately shatters and disappears.
- Creatures inside the Divine Aegis may leave it freely.
- Once a creature willingly leaves the Divine Aegis, it cannot re-enter that same Divine Aegis.
- The Divine Aegis blocks:
  - Weapon attacks.
  - Ammunition and siege projectiles.
  - Magical projectiles.
  - Breath weapons.
  - Area effects that must pass through the barrier.
- Creatures, spells, enchantments, and effects aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** may pass through the Divine Aegis unhindered.
- Interactions with creatures and effects aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** are determined by your patron's **Religious Page**.
- Additional interactions granted through your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

As a Paladin's covenant strengthens, so too does the sanctuary they are able to summon. What begins as a simple refuge grows into a formidable bastion of divine protection, capable of shielding entire companies from devastation. Many military commanders throughout Asteria have witnessed hopeless battles transformed simply because a Divine Aegis stood between their soldiers and certain destruction.

The ancient chronicles describe these barriers as fragments of the divine realm itself, briefly anchored within the mortal world. While they endure, they remind all who behold them that the gods remain ever watchful over those who uphold their sacred covenants.

> *"Every blow that strikes the Aegis is one that never reaches the innocent within."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your Divine Aegis has grown into a true sanctuary of your patron's will. The barrier no longer serves solely as protection from the chaos beyond—it becomes sacred ground where allies may gather, recover, and prepare for the battles yet to come. While the world outside rages with steel, fire, and magic, those within stand beneath the unwavering protection of your patron.

The dome radiates divine authority unique to the deity who empowers it. To the faithful it is a place of hope and refuge; to their enemies it is an unbreakable reminder that the divine still walks beside its chosen champions. Every strike against the barrier weakens its strength, yet every moment it remains standing preserves the lives of those sheltered within.

Whether raised to defend a wounded ally, hold a strategic position, or weather an overwhelming assault, the Divine Aegis stands as one of the greatest miracles a Paladin can bestow upon the battlefield.

### Effects

- Spend **350 MP** and **50 SP** to create a stationary **Divine Aegis** centred on yourself.
- **Cooldown:** Long Rest.
- The Divine Aegis forms a **10-metre radius dome**.
- The Divine Aegis has **450 HP**.
- All physical and magical damage directed at the barrier is dealt to the Divine Aegis instead.
- When the Divine Aegis reaches **0 HP**, it immediately shatters and disappears.
- Creatures inside the Divine Aegis may leave it freely.
- Once a creature willingly leaves the Divine Aegis, it cannot re-enter that same Divine Aegis.
- Creatures sheltered within the Divine Aegis gain **+2 to Saving Throws against hostile magical effects** originating from outside the barrier.
- The Divine Aegis blocks:
  - Weapon attacks.
  - Ammunition and siege projectiles.
  - Magical projectiles.
  - Breath weapons.
  - Area effects that must pass through the barrier.
- Creatures, spells, enchantments, and effects aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** may pass through the Divine Aegis unhindered.
- Interactions with creatures and effects aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** are determined by your patron's **Religious Page**.
- Additional interactions granted through your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

As a Paladin's covenant deepens, the Divine Aegis becomes more than a barrier—it becomes consecrated ground where the faithful gather beneath the watchful gaze of their patron. Ancient chronicles tell of armies surviving impossible sieges because a single champion raised an Aegis that refused to fall until every innocent had escaped.

Many temples teach that the Divine Aegis represents the purest form of protection. It does not exist to imprison or conquer, but to preserve life against overwhelming darkness. Every sanctuary raised upon the battlefield serves as a reminder that hope can endure even when surrounded by despair.

> *"The greatest fortress is not built from stone, but from the promise that those within shall not stand alone."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your Divine Aegis has become a true sanctuary, a sacred refuge where the mortal world briefly yields to the divine authority of your patron. Within its radiant dome, allies find respite from relentless assault while enemies are reminded that even the greatest armies cannot break a covenant blessed by the gods.

The barrier stands unmoving against overwhelming force, absorbing devastating blows that would otherwise shatter those sheltered beneath it. Every strike against its surface echoes like thunder, yet the Aegis endures through the strength of your unwavering faith and the divine power entrusted to you.

Veteran Paladins often use the Divine Aegis not only to defend lives, but to secure battlefields, hold strategic positions, and provide sanctuary during the darkest moments of war.

### Effects

- Spend **400 MP** and **60 SP** to create a stationary **Divine Aegis** centred on yourself.
- **Cooldown:** **Long Rest**.
- The Divine Aegis forms a **12-metre radius dome**.
- The Divine Aegis has **650 HP**.
- All physical and magical damage directed at the barrier is dealt to the Divine Aegis instead.
- When the Divine Aegis reaches **0 HP**, it immediately shatters and disappears.
- Creatures inside the Divine Aegis may leave it freely.
- Once a creature willingly leaves the Divine Aegis, it cannot re-enter that same Divine Aegis.
- Allied creatures inside the Divine Aegis gain **+4 to Saving Throws against hostile magical effects** originating from outside the barrier.
- The Divine Aegis blocks:
  - Weapon attacks.
  - Ammunition and siege projectiles.
  - Magical projectiles.
  - Breath weapons.
  - Area effects that must pass through the barrier.
- Creatures, spells, enchantments, and effects aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** may pass through the Divine Aegis unhindered.
- Interactions with creatures and effects aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** are determined by your patron's **Religious Page**.
- Additional interactions granted through your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

Across Asteria, the appearance of a Rank IV Divine Aegis is regarded as a turning point in any battle. Soldiers who witness its formation often rally with renewed courage, knowing that for a precious time they stand beneath the direct protection of a higher power. Entire cities have survived impossible sieges because a single Paladin raised an Aegis that refused to fall.

The oldest scriptures teach that the Divine Aegis is more than a barrier—it is a fragment of the patron's domain brought into the mortal realm. While its walls remain standing, the faithful fight beneath the reassuring certainty that their patron watches over every soul sheltered within.

> *"Where the Divine Aegis stands, despair finds no refuge."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 5
### Description

Your Divine Aegis has reached its ultimate form, becoming a true manifestation of your patron's divine domain upon the mortal battlefield. Within its radiant walls, allies find sanctuary from devastation while the forces of darkness crash endlessly against an unbreakable testament of faith. Entire armies have rallied beneath such miracles, and legends tell of kingdoms surviving impossible sieges because a single Paladin refused to let the Aegis fall.

The barrier is no longer simply a shield—it is sacred territory. Every strike that shatters against its surface serves as a reminder that divine conviction cannot be broken through force alone. Though your patron's presence lasts only a short time, those fortunate enough to stand beneath the Divine Aegis often describe the experience as standing within the halls of the divine themselves.

Only the greatest champions are ever entrusted with such power. To raise a Rank V Divine Aegis is to demonstrate absolute faith, absolute sacrifice, and an unshakable covenant between patron and protector.

### Effects

- Spend **500 MP** and **70 SP** to create a stationary **Divine Aegis** centred on yourself.
- **Cooldown:** **Long Rest**.
- The Divine Aegis forms a **15-metre radius dome**.
- The Divine Aegis has **1,000 HP**.
- All physical and magical damage directed at the barrier is dealt to the Divine Aegis instead.
- When the Divine Aegis reaches **0 HP**, it immediately shatters and disappears.
- Creatures inside the Divine Aegis may leave it freely.
- Once a creature willingly leaves the Divine Aegis, it cannot re-enter that same Divine Aegis.
- Allied creatures inside the Divine Aegis gain **+4 to Saving Throws** against hostile magical effects originating from outside the barrier.
- Allied creatures inside the Divine Aegis have **Resistance** to damage originating from your patron's **Divine Opposition**.
- The Divine Aegis blocks:
  - Weapon attacks.
  - Ammunition and siege projectiles.
  - Magical projectiles.
  - Breath weapons.
  - Area effects that must pass through the barrier.
- Creatures, spells, enchantments, and effects aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** may pass through the Divine Aegis unhindered.
- Interactions with creatures and effects aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** are determined by your patron's **Religious Page**.
- Additional interactions granted through your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

Throughout the recorded history of Asteria, only a handful of Divine Aegises have ever reached this level of perfection. These sacred sanctuaries are remembered not merely as miracles, but as monuments to unwavering faith. They have preserved cities from annihilation, sheltered innocents from catastrophe, and allowed the faithful to endure against impossible odds until hope returned.

The oldest temples teach that the Divine Aegis is the purest expression of a Paladin's oath. It is not raised to win glory or conquer kingdoms, but to preserve life. While its walls stand, those within know that they are protected not by stone or steel, but by the enduring promise of a patron who has not abandoned their champion.

> *"When the Divine Aegis rises, it is not merely a barrier that stands before the darkness—it is the unwavering promise that hope shall endure."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Prerequisites
None

## Scaling
See individual rank details.

entries.title: Sacred Judgement
entries.body:
# Sacred Judgement

## Overview
There exists no greater authority within the mortal realm than the judgement of a god. Through your unwavering conviction and absolute devotion, your patron grants you the sacred privilege of becoming the vessel through which their divine verdict is delivered. Unlike every miracle before it, Sacred Judgement is not an act of faith—it is the direct expression of your patron's will.

When invoked, your patron looks upon the chosen target and weighs them according to their own divine ideals. Every deity judges differently. Some offer redemption, others deliver destruction. Some restore life, while others demand sacrifice. Mercy, wrath, destiny, chaos, balance, and countless other ideals are all reflected in the judgement bestowed.

No mortal can predict the outcome with certainty, for Sacred Judgement is never governed by the desires of the champion alone. It is the decision of the patron, delivered through their chosen Avatar.

## Rank 1
### Description

There exists no greater authority within the mortal realm than the judgement of a god. Through your unwavering conviction and absolute devotion, your patron grants you the sacred privilege of becoming the vessel through which their divine verdict is delivered. Unlike every miracle before it, Sacred Judgement is not an act of faith—it is the direct expression of your patron's will.

When invoked, your patron looks upon the chosen target and weighs them according to their own divine ideals. Every deity judges differently. Some offer redemption, others deliver destruction. Some restore life, while others demand sacrifice. Mercy, wrath, destiny, chaos, balance, and countless other ideals are all reflected in the judgement bestowed.

No mortal can predict the outcome with certainty, for Sacred Judgement is never governed by the desires of the champion alone. It is the decision of the patron, delivered through their chosen Avatar.

### Effects

- Once per **Campaign Session**, you may invoke **Sacred Judgement**.
- Choose a creature, object, location, or event within **30 metres**.
- Your patron immediately passes divine judgement.
- The exact effect is determined by:
  - Your patron's Divine Authority.
  - Divine Resonance.
  - Divine Opposition.
  - The nature of the target.
  - The current circumstances.
- Sacred Judgement may bless, curse, heal, punish, empower, weaken, cleanse, transform, reveal, banish, or otherwise affect the chosen target in a manner appropriate to your patron.
- The final outcome is determined by the GM and should always reflect the ideals, personality, and divine domain of your patron.
- Sacred Judgement cannot force a result that would fundamentally undermine the campaign or contradict your patron's nature.
- The manifestation of Sacred Judgement is unique to every patron.

### Lore

Throughout history, Sacred Judgement has been witnessed only a handful of times. Entire civilizations have risen or fallen beneath its divine authority, yet no two judgements have ever unfolded in the same way. Every deity views creation through a different lens, and so every verdict reflects the ideals they embody.

The oldest scriptures teach that Sacred Judgement is not an expression of power, but of absolute truth. The champion does not command the miracle—they merely stand aside while their patron's will is made manifest upon the mortal world. Those who survive such moments often find their lives forever changed, whether by blessing, punishment, or revelation.

Among the faithful, it is believed that receiving Sacred Judgement is the closest a mortal may ever come to standing before the gods themselves.

> *"When judgement falls, even kings and monsters stand equal before the eyes of the divine."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your patron now entrusts you with a greater measure of their divine authority, allowing their judgement to reach further and carry greater consequence. You no longer merely invoke a miracle—you become the voice through which your deity pronounces their verdict upon the mortal world. Every judgement reflects not your own desires, but the ideals, purpose, and wisdom of the patron you serve.

Those who witness Sacred Judgement often speak of an overwhelming silence that falls before the miracle unfolds, as though creation itself pauses to hear the will of the divine. Whether the judgement arrives as mercy, punishment, redemption, or revelation depends entirely upon the patron whose authority you carry.

No two judgements are ever identical. Even when faced with similar circumstances, a patron may respond differently according to the sincerity of those involved, the significance of the moment, and the greater purpose they seek to achieve.

### Effects

- Once per **Campaign Session**, you may invoke **Sacred Judgement**.
- Choose a creature, object, location, or event within **40 metres**.
- Your patron immediately passes divine judgement.
- The judgement may affect **multiple closely related targets** when appropriate to the miracle and approved by the GM.
- The exact effect is determined by:
  - Your patron's Divine Authority.
  - Divine Resonance.
  - Divine Opposition.
  - The nature of the target.
  - The current circumstances.
  - The significance and purpose of the judgement.
- Sacred Judgement may bless, curse, heal, punish, empower, weaken, cleanse, transform, reveal, banish, or otherwise affect the chosen target(s) in a manner appropriate to your patron.
- The final outcome is determined by the GM and should always reflect the ideals, personality, and divine domain of your patron.
- Sacred Judgement cannot produce effects that contradict your patron's nature or fundamentally undermine the campaign.
- The appearance and manifestation of Sacred Judgement are unique to your chosen patron.

### Lore

As your covenant deepens, your patron grants you greater authority to act as their earthly representative. Few mortals are ever entrusted with such responsibility, for divine judgement is never given lightly. Every verdict echoes beyond the moment it is delivered, often shaping the destiny of kingdoms, faiths, and generations yet to come.

The High Orders teach that Sacred Judgement is neither vengeance nor mercy alone. It is the perfect expression of a patron's ideals, delivered without fear, prejudice, or hesitation. Those chosen to bear such authority are remembered not for the miracles they performed, but for the wisdom with which they accepted the burden of speaking with a god's voice.

> *"To speak with the voice of the divine is not a privilege—it is a burden few souls are worthy to carry."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 3
### Description

The bond between you and your patron has reached such depth that your voice may now carry a fragment of true divine authority. When you invoke Sacred Judgement, the heavens do not merely observe—they answer. Your patron weighs the hearts, deeds, intentions, and destiny of those before them, delivering a verdict according to their eternal ideals.

To stand before Sacred Judgement is to stand before absolute truth as defined by your patron. Some receive redemption, others condemnation. Some are granted impossible hope, while others witness the consequences of defying the divine. No two judgements are ever identical, for every verdict is shaped by the wisdom of the deity who delivers it.

Those fortunate enough to witness such miracles often spend the remainder of their lives attempting to understand the meaning behind what they have seen.

### Effects

- Once per **Campaign Session**, you may invoke **Sacred Judgement**.
- Choose one or more creatures, objects, locations, or events within **50 metres**, subject to GM approval.
- Your patron delivers a **Greater Sacred Judgement**.
- The judgement may affect individuals, groups, sacred sites, powerful artefacts, or significant events when appropriate.
- The miracle is determined by:
  - Your patron's **Divine Authority**.
  - **Divine Resonance**.
  - **Divine Opposition**.
  - The significance of the target.
  - The current circumstances.
  - The sincerity and purpose of the judgement.
- Greater Sacred Judgements may bless, curse, heal, condemn, empower, weaken, cleanse, transform, reveal hidden truths, banish powerful beings, alter fate, or otherwise reshape events in accordance with your patron's divine portfolio.
- The final outcome is determined by the GM and should always reflect the personality, ideals, and domain of your patron.
- Sacred Judgement can never produce an outcome that contradicts your patron's nature or bypasses the importance of player agency and the ongoing narrative.
- The appearance, manifestation, and consequences of every Sacred Judgement are unique to your chosen patron.

### Lore

Very few mortals have ever spoken with such divine authority. The oldest scriptures describe these champions as living heralds whose words briefly became indistinguishable from the will of the gods themselves. Entire nations have altered their course after witnessing a Greater Sacred Judgement, believing they had seen undeniable proof that the divine still walked among mortals.

The High Orders teach that the burden of Sacred Judgement grows heavier with every rank. To wield such authority is not to command a god, but to accept the immense responsibility of becoming the instrument through which their will is expressed. Every judgement shapes not only the world around it, but also the soul of the champion chosen to bear it.

> *"Power changes kingdoms. Judgement changes history."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your patron now entrusts you with an authority possessed by only the greatest champions in recorded history. Through your unwavering conviction, the boundary between mortal and divine grows perilously thin, allowing your patron's judgement to echo across battlefields, kingdoms, and sacred places alike. When you invoke Sacred Judgement, it is no longer viewed as a miracle—it is recognised as a divine decree that few beings possess the power to challenge.

The judgement delivered is never arbitrary. Every verdict reflects the ideals, wisdom, and eternal purpose of your patron. Some deities restore what has been broken, while others condemn corruption wherever it festers. Some reward sacrifice, while others demand justice. Whatever form it takes, every Sacred Judgement reminds the world that the gods remain active participants in the fate of creation.

Those who witness such miracles often devote their lives to recording every detail, believing future generations must never forget the day a god's will touched the mortal realm.

### Effects

- Once per **Campaign Session**, you may invoke **Sacred Judgement**.
- Choose one or more creatures, objects, sacred sites, locations, or significant events within **100 metres**, subject to GM approval.
- Your patron delivers a **Supreme Sacred Judgement**.
- The judgement may influence battles, armies, cities, sacred sites, legendary artefacts, or other major events appropriate to the campaign.
- The exact miracle is determined by:
  - Your patron's **Divine Authority**.
  - **Divine Resonance**.
  - **Divine Opposition**.
  - The nature and significance of the target.
  - Your standing with your patron.
  - The current circumstances.
- Supreme Sacred Judgements may bless, condemn, heal, empower, weaken, purify, corrupt, banish, transform, reveal, restore, or otherwise reshape reality in a manner consistent with your patron's divine portfolio.
- The GM has final authority over the judgement and should ensure every miracle reflects the ideals, personality, and limitations of the patron.
- Sacred Judgement can never contradict your patron's nature or remove meaningful player choice from the campaign.
- Every manifestation of Sacred Judgement is unique to the patron invoked.

### Lore

Very few Sacred Judgements of this magnitude have ever been witnessed. The oldest chronicles speak of wars ending in a single divine decree, cursed kingdoms restored through impossible mercy, and ancient evils cast from the world by champions whose faith never wavered. Such moments became defining events in history, remembered long after empires had risen and fallen.

The High Orders teach that a Supreme Sacred Judgement is never a display of power alone. It is the greatest expression of trust a patron can place in a mortal, allowing them to become the voice through which eternal ideals are briefly spoken into the world. Every champion who reaches this stage understands that the burden of divine authority is far greater than the power it grants.

> *"The greatest judgement is not the one that ends a war, but the one that teaches the world why it began."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 5
### Description

There exists no greater authority that a mortal may wield than the Sacred Judgement of their patron. Through absolute conviction, unwavering devotion, and a covenant forged through countless sacrifices, you have become the chosen vessel through which your patron may deliver their ultimate verdict upon the mortal realm.

When Sacred Judgement is invoked, your patron alone decides the outcome. Mortals cannot bargain, reason, or resist through will alone. Every judgement reflects the ideals, wisdom, mercy, wrath, justice, or purpose of the deity who delivers it. Some are granted redemption, others face condemnation. Entire kingdoms have been saved through a single judgement, while others have watched centuries of corruption brought to an end in a single divine decree.

Those who witness a Rank V Sacred Judgement rarely describe the miracle itself. Instead, they speak of an overwhelming certainty that, for one fleeting moment, they stood before the unquestionable authority of the divine.

### Effects

- Once per **Campaign Session**, you may invoke **Sacred Judgement**.
- Choose one or more creatures, objects, sacred relics, locations, armies, kingdoms, or significant events, subject to GM approval.
- Your patron delivers their **Ultimate Sacred Judgement**.
- The judgement may influence any appropriate target whose scale is reasonable within the current campaign.
- The judgement is determined by:
  - Your patron's **Divine Authority**.
  - Your patron's **Divine Resonance**.
  - Your patron's **Divine Opposition**.
  - The significance of the target.
  - The sincerity of your conviction.
  - Your standing with your patron.
  - The current state of the world and campaign.
- Ultimate Sacred Judgements may bless, condemn, heal, purge, restore, transform, banish, reveal, protect, destroy, alter destiny, or otherwise perform miracles consistent with your patron's divine portfolio.
- The GM has final authority over every judgement and should ensure that each miracle reflects the patron's personality, ideals, limitations, and role within the world.
- Sacred Judgement can never contradict your patron's nature, bypass meaningful player agency, or permanently undermine the integrity of the campaign.
- Every manifestation of Sacred Judgement is entirely unique to the patron invoked.

### Lore

The scriptures speak of only a handful of champions throughout history who have ever borne the authority to invoke the Ultimate Sacred Judgement. Their names became inseparable from the gods they served, remembered not for the power they possessed, but for the unwavering conviction that earned such unimaginable trust.

The High Orders teach that Sacred Judgement is not a weapon, nor a spell, nor even a miracle. It is the moment a deity chooses to speak directly into the mortal world through the soul of their most faithful servant. Whether that voice brings hope, justice, destruction, mercy, or renewal depends entirely upon the patron who answers the call.

Those who survive such moments often spend the remainder of their lives recounting the experience, for they know they have witnessed something that few mortals ever shall—the unmistakable will of a god made manifest.

> *"Power belongs to champions. Judgement belongs to the gods. We are merely the voices they choose when the world must listen."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Prerequisites
None

## Synergy

entries.title: Aura Reading
entries.body:
# Aura Reading

## Overview
Every magical element leaves behind a unique essence that permeates the world around it. Through meditation and years of study, Druids learn to open their senses beyond ordinary sight, allowing them to perceive these elemental auras.

Unlike other forms of magical detection, Aura Reading is limited by the Druid's own understanding. You can only perceive the elemental essences of magical elements you have personally mastered. As your knowledge of magic grows, so too does your ability to interpret the unseen world.

Because Earth is the foundation of every Druid's training, its essence speaks more clearly than any other. The land willingly reveals details that remain hidden within other elemental auras.

---

## Rank 1
### Description

Every magical element leaves behind a unique essence that permeates the world around it. Through meditation and years of study, Druids learn to open their senses beyond ordinary sight, allowing them to perceive these elemental auras.

Unlike other forms of magical detection, Aura Reading is limited by the Druid's own understanding. You can only perceive the elemental essences of magical elements you have personally mastered. As your knowledge of magic grows, so too does your ability to interpret the unseen world.

Because Earth is the foundation of every Druid's training, its essence speaks more clearly than any other. The land willingly reveals details that remain hidden within other elemental auras.

---

### Effects

- Activate **Aura Reading** by spending **10 MP**.
- While active, Aura Reading costs **5 MP every 5 seconds** to maintain.
- Aura Reading lasts for up to **5 minutes**, or until manually dismissed.
- Detect the **elemental essence** of all magical elements you currently know within **10 metres**.
- Each known magical element appears as a distinct aura, allowing you to identify its elemental affinity.
- **Earth Essence** reveals whether the aura originates from a **creature**, an **enchanted object**, or an **active Earth spell**.
- Gain **+1 to D20 Perception Checks** when locating creatures, magical objects, or magical effects emitting a known elemental essence.
- Aura Reading requires **line of sight** and cannot perceive through solid objects such as walls, dense stone, metal, or sealed containers.
- At this rank, Aura Reading only reveals the **presence** and **elemental affinity** of an aura. It does not reveal the aura's strength, duration, magical effect, or lingering magical residue.

---

### Lore

The oldest Druids teach that every element sings its own silent song. Stone hums with patience, rivers whisper with change, flames roar with passion, and the wind carries stories beyond the horizon. To those without training, these voices are forever silent. To a Druid, they become as clear as daylight.

Every apprentice begins by learning to recognise the steady heartbeat of Earth. Only after mastering this first elemental essence can they hope to understand the countless other energies that weave together the natural world.

Aura Reading is not about seeing magic—it is about recognising the elemental truths that lie beneath it. Every new magical element a Druid learns adds another voice to the chorus, slowly revealing the hidden tapestry of Asteria.

---

> *"Magic hides from the eyes, but never from the elements that gave it form."*  
> — **Grand Archdruid Rowan Thornbark, First Warden of the Emerald Wilds**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your connection to the elemental essences of the world has strengthened, allowing you to perceive them with greater clarity and understanding. Where once you could only identify an elemental affinity, you can now begin to interpret the condition of that essence and recognise subtle differences between natural, sustained, and fading magic.

As your mastery grows, every magical element you know becomes easier to distinguish. The Earth, however, continues to offer deeper insight than any other, revealing details that remain hidden within other elemental essences.

---

### Effects

- Activate **Aura Reading** by spending **15 MP**.
- While active, Aura Reading costs **5 MP every 5 seconds** to maintain.
- Aura Reading lasts for up to **10 minutes**, or until manually dismissed.
- Detect the **elemental essence** of all magical elements you currently know within **15 metres**.
- Each known magical element appears as a distinct aura, allowing you to identify its elemental affinity.
- You can determine whether a known elemental aura is:
  - **Natural**
  - **Enchanted**
  - **Actively channelled**
  - **Lingering**
- **Earth Essence** reveals whether the aura originates from a **creature**, **object**, **active spell**, or **lingering magical residue**.
- Gain **+2 to D20 Perception Checks** when locating creatures, magical objects, or magical effects emitting a known elemental essence.
- Aura Reading requires **line of sight** and cannot perceive through solid objects such as walls, dense stone, metal, or sealed containers.
- Aura Reading still does not reveal an aura's exact spell, enchantment, strength, or magical effects.

---

### Lore

To an experienced Druid, every elemental essence carries its own rhythm. Some burn brightly with active power, while others linger like fading footprints left behind by ancient magic. Learning to distinguish these subtle differences is the first step towards truly understanding the language of the elements.

The elder circles teach that the Earth is the oldest witness to every spell ever cast. Though other elements reveal their presence, it is the patient memory of stone and soil that often uncovers truths long after the magic itself has faded.

With practice, a Druid begins to realise that Aura Reading is not merely about seeing magic—it is about listening to the stories each element leaves behind.

---

> *"The wise do not ask whether magic was used. They ask what the elements remember."*  
> — **Grand Archdruid Rowan Thornbark, First Warden of the Emerald Wilds**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your understanding of elemental essences has grown beyond simple observation. You no longer perceive magic as isolated auras, but as flowing energies that interact with the world around them. Every known element leaves behind a unique signature, allowing you to distinguish recent magic from ancient enchantments and stable energies from those on the verge of collapse.

The Earth continues to guide your perception more clearly than any other element. Its patient nature reveals traces of magic that others overlook, preserving echoes of events long after they have passed.

As your magical knowledge expands, Aura Reading automatically adapts, allowing every magical element you have mastered to be interpreted with the same growing level of understanding.

---

### Effects

- Activate **Aura Reading** by spending **20 MP**.
- While active, Aura Reading costs **5 MP every 5 seconds** to maintain.
- Aura Reading lasts for up to **15 minutes**, or until manually dismissed.
- Detect the **elemental essence** of all magical elements you currently know within **20 metres**.
- Each known magical element appears as a distinct aura, allowing you to identify its elemental affinity.
- You can determine whether an aura is:
  - **Natural**
  - **Enchanted**
  - **Actively channelled**
  - **Lingering**
- You can judge the **relative strength** of a known aura as **Faint**, **Moderate**, or **Powerful**.
- **Earth Essence** additionally reveals whether the aura was created **recently** or has remained in the area for an extended period.
- Gain **+3 to D20 Perception Checks** when locating creatures, magical objects, or magical effects emitting a known elemental essence.
- Aura Reading requires **line of sight** and cannot perceive through solid objects such as walls, dense stone, metal, or sealed containers.
- Aura Reading does not reveal the exact spell, enchantment, or magical effect responsible for an aura.

---

### Lore

To the untrained eye, magic appears as little more than flashes of power. To an experienced Druid, every elemental essence carries a history. Stone remembers every enchantment carved into it, rivers carry the echoes of ancient rituals, and even the wind bears traces of spells cast moments before.

The elders teach that understanding the age and strength of an aura is often more valuable than knowing its purpose. A fading essence may speak of a traveller long gone, while a powerful aura lingering in silence may warn of dangers yet to awaken.

Only those who patiently study the language of the elements begin to realise that magic is never truly fleeting—it always leaves a story for those capable of reading it.

---

> *"Magic may fade from sight, but the elements never forget who called upon them."*  
> — **Grand Archdruid Rowan Thornbark, First Warden of the Emerald Wilds**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your perception of elemental essences has become exceptionally refined. Every magical element you have mastered reveals not only its presence, but also the story behind its use. The invisible currents of magic are no longer isolated traces—they become interconnected patterns that reveal how elemental forces shape the world.

The Earth remains your greatest teacher. Stone and soil preserve echoes of magic long after other elements have faded, allowing you to uncover details hidden from less experienced practitioners. As you continue to master new magical elements, Aura Reading expands alongside your knowledge, granting deeper understanding of every essence you have learned.

To veteran Druids, the world itself becomes an open tome, its pages written not with ink, but with the lingering essence of elemental magic.

---

### Effects

- Activate **Aura Reading** by spending **25 MP**.
- While active, Aura Reading costs **5 MP every 5 seconds** to maintain.
- Aura Reading lasts for up to **20 minutes**, or until manually dismissed.
- Detect the **elemental essence** of all magical elements you currently know within **25 metres**.
- Each known magical element appears as a distinct aura, allowing you to identify its elemental affinity.
- You can determine whether an aura is:
  - **Natural**
  - **Enchanted**
  - **Actively channelled**
  - **Lingering**
- You can determine whether an aura is **Weak**, **Minor**, **Greater**, or **Strengthened**.
- You can recognise whether multiple known elemental essences are interacting with one another.
- **Earth Essence** additionally reveals whether the magical essence is **stable**, **fractured**, or **corrupted**, helping identify damaged enchantments, unstable rituals, or tainted Earth magic.
- Gain **+4 to D20 Perception Checks** when locating creatures, magical objects, or magical effects emitting a known elemental essence.
- Aura Reading requires **line of sight** and cannot perceive through solid objects such as walls, dense stone, metal, or sealed containers.
- Aura Reading still cannot identify the exact spell, enchantment, or technique responsible for an aura.

---

### Lore

Among the oldest Druidic Circles, reaching this level of Aura Reading is considered the mark of a true elemental scholar. Few possess the patience required to study the subtle differences between magical essences, and fewer still can interpret the countless interactions that occur whenever multiple elements converge.

The Earth is said to remember every spell ever cast upon it. Ancient standing stones, forgotten temples, and sacred groves often bear echoes of powerful rituals that only the most accomplished Druids can perceive. By reading these lingering impressions, entire histories have been uncovered without a single written record.

Those who witness a master of Aura Reading often believe they are simply staring into empty space. In truth, the Druid is observing a vibrant tapestry of elemental essences woven together across the world, each one telling a story to those capable of understanding its silent language.

---

> *"The greatest mysteries are never hidden. They are simply written in a language few have learned to read."*  
> — **Grand Archdruid Rowan Thornbark, First Warden of the Emerald Wilds**

## Rank 5
### Description

Your understanding of elemental essences has reached its pinnacle. Every magical element you have mastered reveals itself with remarkable clarity, allowing you to read the invisible tapestry of magic woven throughout the world. To you, elemental auras are no longer fleeting glimmers of power—they are expressions of the forces that shape life, nature, and the world itself.

Each magical element tells a different story, and your growing mastery allows you to interpret only those elements you truly understand. A Druid who has devoted themselves to Earth sees the silent memories preserved within stone, while one who has studied Water perceives its endless flow and purity. No two Druids perceive the world in exactly the same way, for Aura Reading reflects the magical knowledge of its wielder.

The Earth remains your greatest teacher. Its essence reveals truths hidden even from the most experienced practitioners of other magical disciplines, making it the cornerstone of every Druid's perception.

---

### Effects

- Activate **Aura Reading** by spending **30 MP**.
- While active, Aura Reading costs **5 MP every 5 seconds** to maintain.
- Aura Reading lasts for up to **30 minutes**, or until manually dismissed.
- Detect the **elemental essence** of all magical elements you currently know within **30 metres**.
- Each known magical element appears as a distinct aura, allowing you to immediately identify its elemental affinity.
- You can determine whether an aura is:
  - **Natural**
  - **Enchanted**
  - **Actively Channelled**
  - **Lingering**
- You can determine an aura's magical strength as:
  - **Weak**
  - **Minor**
  - **Greater**
  - **Strengthened**
- You can recognise when multiple elemental essences are interacting and identify each known element involved.
- **Earth Essence** reveals whether the aura originates from a **creature**, **object**, **spell**, **enchantment**, or **ritual**, and whether the Earth's essence is **stable**, **fractured**, or **corrupted**.
- Gain **+5 to D20 Perception Checks** when locating creatures, magical objects, enchantments, or magical effects emitting a known elemental essence.
- Aura Reading requires **line of sight** and cannot perceive through solid objects such as walls, dense stone, metal, or sealed containers.
- Aura Reading only interprets the elemental essences you have personally learned. Unknown magical elements remain visible as unidentified magical auras.

---

### Lore

To the Archdruids of old, Aura Reading was never considered a spell—it was a way of perceiving the world as the elements themselves do. Every stone remembers, every river carries echoes, every flame leaves passion in its wake, and every breeze whispers of distant lands. Those who master this talent become living interpreters of these silent voices.

It is said that the greatest Druids could walk through forgotten ruins and recount centuries of magical history simply by observing the elemental essences lingering within the walls. They needed no written records, for the world itself preserved every story in the language of the elements.

Though many practitioners of magic seek greater power, Druids believe true wisdom comes from understanding. Aura Reading stands as the embodiment of that belief, reminding every Druid that magic is not merely cast—it is woven into the very fabric of Asteria.

---

> *"The elements have never hidden their truths. They have only waited for someone patient enough to learn their language."*  
> — **Grand Archdruid Rowan Thornbark, First Warden of the Emerald Wilds**

## Prerequisites
None

## Scaling
See individual rank details.

## Synergy
Information coming soon.

## GM Notes
GM-only information coming soon.

entries.title: Chlorokinesis
entries.body:
# Chlorokinesis

## Overview
You awaken your first true connection to the living plants around you. By weaving Mana into nearby vegetation and directing it through physical effort, you can command roots, vines, branches, shrubs, and grasses to move at your will.

Unlike conjuration magic, Chlorokinesis cannot create plant life from nothing. Instead, it manipulates vegetation that already exists within the environment, making the battlefield itself an extension of your abilities. Even the smallest patch of roots or overgrown vines can become a useful tool in the hands of a skilled Druid.

Though your control is still limited, you quickly learn that nature rarely needs overwhelming force. A single root can halt a charging enemy, a bent branch can shelter an ally, and a moving vine can uncover what was once hidden.

---

## Rank 1
### Description

You awaken your first true connection to the living plants around you. By weaving Mana into nearby vegetation and directing it through physical effort, you can command roots, vines, branches, shrubs, and grasses to move at your will.

Unlike conjuration magic, Chlorokinesis cannot create plant life from nothing. Instead, it manipulates vegetation that already exists within the environment, making the battlefield itself an extension of your abilities. Even the smallest patch of roots or overgrown vines can become a useful tool in the hands of a skilled Druid.

Though your control is still limited, you quickly learn that nature rarely needs overwhelming force. A single root can halt a charging enemy, a bent branch can shelter an ally, and a moving vine can uncover what was once hidden.

---

### Effects

When casting **Chlorokinesis**, choose **one** of the following techniques:

#### 🌱 Root Snare

Command nearby roots or vines to hinder a creature's movement.

- Target one creature within range.
- The target must make a **D20 Agility Saving Throw** against your **Spell Save DC**.
- **Failure:** The target's movement speed is reduced by **50%** until the end of its next turn.
- **Success:** The target's movement speed is reduced by **25%** until the end of its next turn.

#### 🌿 Living Cover

Manipulate nearby branches, shrubs, or vines to provide protection.

Choose one:

- Grant one creature **Half Cover** until the start of your next turn.
- Create a **2-metre** patch of **Difficult Terrain** until the start of your next turn.

#### 🍃 Verdant Utility

Use nearby vegetation to assist outside of combat.

Examples include:

- Moving vines into climbing ropes.
- Clearing overgrown pathways.
- Revealing hidden tracks or objects.
- Pulling a light object within range.
- Moving foliage to improve visibility.

- Gain **+10** to one **Nature**, **Survival**, or **Tracking** **D100 Skill Check** related to the action.

---

### Lore

Among the Druidic Circles, Chlorokinesis is considered the first lesson in working alongside nature rather than commanding it. Young Druids are taught that every plant possesses its own purpose, and their role is simply to guide that purpose instead of forcing it.

Many apprentices spend months practising with a single vine before they are trusted to manipulate larger plants. The exercise is less about power and more about patience, teaching that even the smallest movement can change the outcome of a journey or battle.

To an outsider, the forest may appear still. To a Druid, every leaf, root, and branch is waiting for a gentle request.

---

> *"Do not ask how strong a tree is. Ask how willing it is to help."*  
> — **Archdruid Rowan Thornbark, Warden of the Emerald Wilds**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your bond with the natural world deepens, allowing your influence over plants to become stronger, faster, and more deliberate. The vegetation around you no longer reacts with hesitation—it answers your call with growing confidence.

Roots spread farther beneath the earth, vines tighten with greater strength, and branches bend more naturally to your commands. What once required careful concentration now feels instinctive, allowing you to adapt the battlefield in moments.

Experienced Druids understand that victory is not always won through overwhelming force. Restricting a foe's movement, shielding an ally from danger, or opening a safe path through dense wilderness can prove just as decisive as any spell. Chlorokinesis teaches that nature rewards those who think ahead, shaping the environment to favour patience, preparation, and harmony.

---

### Effects

When casting **Chlorokinesis**, choose **one** of the following techniques:

#### 🌱 Root Snare

Command roots and vines to bind a creature's legs.

- Target one creature within range.
- The target must make a **D20 Agility Saving Throw** against your **Spell Save DC**.
- **Failure:** The target becomes **Snared** until the end of its next turn.
  - A Snared creature's movement becomes **0 metres**.
- **Success:** The target's movement speed is reduced by **50%** until the end of its next turn.

#### 🌿 Living Cover

Command nearby vegetation to grow into a stronger defensive position.

Choose one:

- Grant one creature **Half Cover** until the start of your next turn.
- Create a **3-metre** area of **Difficult Terrain** that lasts for **2 rounds**.
- Block a narrow passage with dense vines or branches, requiring a creature to spend **2 metres of movement for every metre travelled** through the obstacle.

#### 🍃 Verdant Utility

Manipulate surrounding plant life to assist exploration and survival.

Examples include:

- Growing stronger vine ladders.
- Retrieving objects from difficult locations.
- Revealing concealed paths.
- Stabilising loose terrain.
- Clearing dense undergrowth.
- Pulling or pushing unattended objects using vines.

- Gain **+15** to one **Nature**, **Survival**, or **Tracking** **D100 Skill Check** related to the chosen action.

---

### Lore

As Druids continue to refine Chlorokinesis, they discover that plants possess remarkable resilience and adaptability. Every root searches endlessly for water, every vine seeks something to climb, and every branch instinctively reaches toward the light.

Rather than forcing these instincts, experienced practitioners simply encourage them. This philosophy lies at the heart of Druidic teaching: nature is strongest when allowed to follow its own course.

Those who master this lesson begin to view every forest, meadow, and overgrown ruin not as scenery, but as a living companion ready to answer their call.

---

> *"Power is not making the forest obey. Power is asking so gently that it chooses to."*  
> — **Archdruid Rowan Thornbark, Warden of the Emerald Wilds**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your mastery of Chlorokinesis allows you to command multiple plants with confidence, transforming the natural world into a powerful extension of your will. What once required careful focus now flows instinctively, as roots burst from the earth, vines lash outward, and branches bend to answer your call.

The battlefield itself begins to change around you. Dense undergrowth becomes a hindrance to your enemies, towering trees become living shields, and tangled vines become relentless restraints. Every forest, meadow, and overgrown ruin offers new opportunities to shape the course of battle.

Veteran Druids know that nature does not seek to destroy—it seeks to endure. By redirecting that enduring strength, they can halt advancing foes, protect companions, and manipulate the terrain without disturbing the balance they have sworn to preserve.

---

### Effects

When casting **Chlorokinesis**, choose **one** of the following techniques:

#### 🌱 Entangling Roots

Command a network of roots and vines to erupt beneath your enemies.

- Choose a **3-metre radius** within range.
- All creatures in the area must make a **D20 Agility Saving Throw** against your **Spell Save DC**.
- **Failure:** The creature becomes **Restrained** until the end of its next turn.
- **Success:** The creature's movement speed is reduced by **50%** until the end of its next turn.
- The affected area becomes **Difficult Terrain** for **3 rounds**.

#### 🌿 Living Barrier

Weave branches, vines, and shrubs into a durable natural wall.

Choose one:

- Create a **4-metre-wide**, **2-metre-high** living barrier that grants **Three-Quarters Cover**.
- Create a **4-metre** area of **Difficult Terrain** that lasts for **3 rounds**.
- Seal a doorway, pathway, or narrow passage with dense vegetation. The obstruction can be cleared with a successful **Strength Check** against your **Spell Save DC**.

#### 🍃 Verdant Utility

Manipulate large amounts of vegetation to aid exploration or survival.

Examples include:

- Creating stable vine bridges.
- Revealing concealed trails or entrances.
- Moving fallen trees or heavy branches.
- Constructing temporary platforms.
- Clearing dense vegetation for safe travel.
- Retrieving distant objects using living vines.

- Gain **+20** to one **Nature**, **Survival**, or **Tracking** **D100 Skill Check** related to the chosen action.

---

### Lore

By the third stage of Chlorokinesis, a Druid no longer sees individual plants—they see an interconnected living system. Every root communicates through the earth, every vine searches for support, and every tree contributes to the harmony of the forest.

Experienced Druids become conductors of this silent symphony, encouraging countless plants to work together toward a single purpose. Their power does not come from domination, but from understanding how every part of nature supports another.

It is said that when an Archdruid enters an ancient forest, the woodland recognises them long before they speak. Leaves rustle without wind, branches bow gently aside, and roots shift beneath their feet—not from magic alone, but from mutual respect between guardian and grove.

---

> *"One vine may catch a traveller. A thousand vines may change the course of a battle."*  
> — **Archdruid Rowan Thornbark, Warden of the Emerald Wilds**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your communion with the natural world has reached a level where entire groves answer your call without hesitation. Roots surge through the earth with tremendous force, towering hedges rise within moments, and ancient branches twist into formidable barriers. Every living plant within your reach becomes a willing extension of your intent.

At this stage, Chlorokinesis is no longer simply about controlling individual plants—it is about shaping the battlefield itself. Dense vegetation slows advancing enemies, towering walls protect your allies, and the wilderness bends to create paths where none existed before.

Master Druids understand that nature is neither cruel nor merciful. It simply adapts. By embracing this lesson, you learn to guide the forest's endless resilience, turning even the smallest patch of greenery into a decisive advantage.

---

### Effects

When casting **Chlorokinesis**, choose **one** of the following techniques:

#### 🌱 Verdant Grasp

Command an immense network of roots and vines to erupt across the battlefield.

- Choose a **5-metre radius** within range.
- All creatures in the area must make a **D20 Agility Saving Throw** against your **Spell Save DC**.
- **Failure:** The creature becomes **Restrained** for **2 rounds**.
- **Success:** The creature's movement speed is reduced by **50%** for **2 rounds**.
- The affected area becomes **Difficult Terrain** for **4 rounds**.

#### 🌿 Living Bastion

Shape surrounding vegetation into a powerful defensive structure.

Choose one:

- Create a living wall up to **6 metres wide** and **3 metres high** that grants **Full Cover**.
- Create a **6-metre** area of **Difficult Terrain** for **4 rounds**.
- Seal a doorway, bridge, tunnel, or narrow passage with dense vegetation. Creatures must succeed on a **Strength Check** against your **Spell Save DC** to force their way through.

#### 🍃 Verdant Dominion

Command large sections of natural vegetation to assist exploration and survival.

Examples include:

- Creating broad vine bridges capable of supporting a party.
- Opening safe routes through dense forests.
- Stabilising collapsing embankments or hillsides.
- Raising natural platforms for climbing.
- Revealing hidden ruins or forgotten pathways.
- Manipulating large trees, shrubs, and vines to reshape the surrounding environment.

- Gain **+25** to one **Nature**, **Survival**, or **Tracking** **D100 Skill Check** related to the chosen action.

---

### Lore

Among the oldest Druidic Circles, this level of mastery is known as **The Forest's Embrace**. It marks the point where a Druid ceases to feel like an individual standing within nature and instead becomes part of its living rhythm.

Veteran Druids often describe hearing the quiet whispers of roots beneath the soil and sensing the slow heartbeat of ancient trees. To them, every forest is a community of countless lives working together, each willing to lend its strength when called upon with respect.

Few sights inspire greater caution than a master of Chlorokinesis standing calmly within an ancient woodland. For while the Druid may appear alone, the forest itself has already risen to stand beside them.

---

> *"The forest does not march to war. It simply reminds trespassers that they were never alone."*  
> — **Archdruid Rowan Thornbark, Warden of the Emerald Wilds**

## Rank 5
### Description

You have achieved true mastery over Chlorokinesis, becoming a living conduit through which the natural world expresses its will. The distinction between your command and the forest's response has all but disappeared. With little more than a thought, roots erupt from the earth, towering hedgerows rise into defensive fortifications, and ancient trees bend their branches to shield those under your protection.

Where novice Druids manipulate individual plants, you orchestrate entire ecosystems. Every vine, shrub, flower, and towering tree within your reach contributes to a unified purpose. The battlefield itself becomes alive, restricting your enemies while providing sanctuary for your allies.

To those who witness this mastery, it appears as though the forest itself has awakened. Yet experienced Druids know the truth—they are not rulers of nature, but trusted guardians who have earned its unwavering cooperation through years of respect and understanding.

---

### Effects

When casting **Chlorokinesis**, choose **one** of the following techniques:

#### 🌱 Forest's Embrace

Command an immense network of roots, vines, and vegetation to seize the battlefield.

- Choose an **8-metre radius** within range.
- All creatures in the area must make a **D20 Agility Saving Throw** against your **Spell Save DC**.
- **Failure:** The creature becomes **Restrained** for **2 rounds**.
- **Success:** The creature's movement speed is reduced by **50%** for **3 rounds**.
- The affected area becomes **Difficult Terrain** for **5 rounds**.
- A creature restrained by this ability may use its action to repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

#### 🌿 Verdant Fortress

Shape the surrounding vegetation into a formidable natural stronghold.

Choose one:

- Create a living structure up to **8 metres wide** and **4 metres high** that grants **Full Cover**.
- Create an **8-metre** area of **Difficult Terrain** lasting **5 rounds**.
- Seal a large doorway, bridge, canyon pass, or similar opening with dense vegetation. Creatures must succeed on a **Strength Check** against your **Spell Save DC** to force a passage.

#### 🍃 Nature's Dominion

Exercise complete control over nearby vegetation to overcome environmental challenges.

Examples include:

- Constructing large vine bridges capable of supporting groups and mounts.
- Clearing extensive overgrowth to reveal roads or ruins.
- Raising natural platforms and stairways through trees or cliffs.
- Moving fallen trees and dense vegetation to reshape the landscape.
- Concealing campsites or entrances beneath living foliage.
- Guiding large sections of vegetation to create safe travel routes.

- Gain **+30** to one **Nature**, **Survival**, or **Tracking** **D100 Skill Check** related to the chosen action.

---

### Lore

Only a handful of Druids within each generation reach this level of communion with the living world. They are no longer recognised merely as practitioners of Chlorokinesis, but as true Wardens of the Wild—individuals whose presence alone calms forests and stirs ancient groves into quiet life.

Legends tell of these masters halting invading armies without drawing blood, raising forests to block advancing forces, and restoring devastated lands simply by guiding nature back into balance. Such feats are remembered not because they display overwhelming power, but because they embody perfect harmony between mortal and wilderness.

The oldest circles teach that this is not the end of a Druid's journey, but the beginning of a deeper responsibility. Once the forest answers your every call, it also begins to trust you with its future.

---

> *"Mastery is not the moment the forest obeys you. It is the moment the forest believes your voice is its own."*  
> — **Grand Archdruid Rowan Thornbark, First Warden of the Emerald Wilds**

## Prerequisites
None

## Scaling
See individual rank details.

## Synergy
Information coming soon.
